why_it_moved.text: CTR rose 2.10% mostly through its denominator. Queries per User fell 1.90% while Clicks per User stayed flat (+0.10%): same clicks over fewer searches.
why_it_moved.label: measured

why_it_moved.text: Successful Search Rate rose 0.81%, but Long Click Rate (-0.03%), Reformulation Rate and Abandonment Rate did not improve, so a pure relevance gain is not yet shown.
why_it_moved.label: inferred

why_it_moved.text: Segment cuts of Successful Search Rate are all flat or negative (Informational -0.89%) though the total rose; search mix may differ between arms.
why_it_moved.label: guess

would_change: Success on triggered queries flat while untriggered carries the lift, or the lift tied to the Queries per User drop, would make the win a counting effect.
A pre-exposure comparison showing the arms already differed on Successful Search Rate would void the result.
Segment mix shifting between arms in a per-user cut would explain the segment-versus-total gap.
